concepts.concept: Bus access decode and eligibility (strobe, read/write, address bit) that selects control registers vs data FIFOs
concepts.writers: External bus master via port bus_req_i: fields bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2) are sampled in the bus_access process and route writes/reads to control fields (bus_access lines 170-179) and to FIFOs (tx_fifo.we at line 261, rx_fifo.re at line 307).
concepts.observers: Bus response and status visible to the bus master: bus_rsp_o.ack (line 170) and bus_rsp_o.data (lines 195-219) show control-field vs FIFO responses (e.g. line 217 shows FIFO readout).

confidentiality.reason: The bus response copies either control fields or FIFO data to bus_rsp_o.data (e.g. line 217), so the decode decision is observable and not secret.

integrity.reason: Routing into FIFOs and control fields is driven directly by bus_req_i fields (tx_fifo.we uses bus_req_i.stb/rw/addr at line 261) with no protection, so an external bus can change the decode.

availability.reason: The bus_access process only performs an access when bus_req_i.stb = '1' (line 176), so an external master can block or enable access routing and thereby stop decode-driven activity.

undermined behavior.reason: The selection is performed only by the sampled bus_req_i fields in the bus_access process (lines 170-179) and there is no alternate debug/test bypass present.

concepts.concept: Module enable bit (ctrl.enable) that gates most UART behavior
concepts.writers: Written by control writes: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in the bus_access process (line 179) under the bus write guard (bus_req_i.stb/rw/addr); reset writes ctrl.enable <= '0' at line 156.
concepts.observers: Readback via bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_en_c) at line 195 and exported directly to the external clkgen_en_o port at line 228; it also gates IRQs and RTS logic (examples at lines 270, 315, 472).

confidentiality.reason: ctrl.enable is copied to the external output clkgen_en_o (line 228) and also read back via the bus (line 195), so its value is externally observable.

integrity.reason: ctrl.enable is written directly from bus_req_i.data at line 179 and can be changed while the UART operates, affecting downstream gating.

availability.reason: tx_engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable (line 344) so clearing ctrl.enable externally disables the transmitter and can halt progress.

undermined behavior.reason: At runtime ctrl.enable is driven only by the bus write at line 179 (and reset at 156); there is no alternate override mode.

concepts.concept: Baud-rate configuration (ctrl.baud) used to load TX/RX baud counters
concepts.writers: Written by control writes: ctrl.baud <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_baud9_c downto ctrl_baud0_c) in the bus_access process (line 183) under the bus write guard; reset writes zeros at line 160.
concepts.observers: Readback via bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_baud9_c downto ctrl_baud0_c) at line 199; the register is also copied into engine baud counters (examples at lines 349, 368 and 432).

confidentiality.reason: ctrl.baud is returned on bus reads at line 199, so its configured value is observable externally.

integrity.reason: ctrl.baud is written directly from bus_req_i.data at line 183 and may be changed while the TX/RX engines use it, altering UART timing.

availability.reason: ctrl.baud updates are ordinary clocked control writes (line 183) and there is no external condition that freezes its update.

undermined behavior.reason: ctrl.baud has a single runtime driver (bus write at line 183) and no debug/test bypass is present.

concepts.concept: Prescaler index (ctrl.prsc) that selects which clkgen_i bit yields uart_clk
concepts.writers: Written by control writes: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c) in bus_access (line 182) under the bus write guard; reset initializes to zeros at line 159.
concepts.observers: Readback via bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c) at line 198; the index selects uart_clk with uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) at line 229, affecting externally visible UART timing and outputs.

confidentiality.reason: ctrl.prsc is returned on bus reads at line 198, so its value can be learned externally.

integrity.reason: ctrl.prsc is written directly from bus_req_i.data at line 182 and can be changed while uart_clk is relied upon, altering selected clocking.

availability.reason: ctrl.prsc updates are standard clocked writes (line 182) and nothing in the RTL blocks its update.

undermined behavior.reason: ctrl.prsc has a single runtime driver (line 182) and there is no alternate override path.

concepts.concept: Hardware flow-control enable (ctrl.hwfc_en) that changes CTS/RTS gating
concepts.writers: Written by control writes: ctrl.hwfc_en <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_hwfc_en_c) in bus_access (line 181) under the bus write guard; reset sets to '0' at line 158.
concepts.observers: Readback via bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_hwfc_en_c) at line 197; it also affects RTS output in rtr_control (lines 472-477) and gating in the transmitter (line 359), making its effect externally observable.

confidentiality.reason: ctrl.hwfc_en is returned on bus reads at line 197 and thus externally observable.

integrity.reason: ctrl.hwfc_en is written directly from bus_req_i.data at line 181 and can be changed during operation, altering flow-control decisions.

availability.reason: ctrl.hwfc_en is updated by ordinary clocked writes (line 181) and there is no external condition that freezes the bit.

undermined behavior.reason: At runtime the bit is driven only by the bus write (line 181); no debug/test bypass is present.

concepts.concept: Simulation-mode flag (ctrl.sim_mode) that forces FIFO clears and enables the simulation transmitter
concepts.writers: Written by control writes: ctrl.sim_mode <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_sim_en_c) and bool_to_ulogic_f(sim_mode_en_c) (line 180) under the bus write guard; reset sets ctrl.sim_mode <= '0' at line 157; note the assignment is ANDed with the compile-time sim_mode_en_c gate.
concepts.observers: Its effects are externally visible because ctrl.sim_mode asserts tx_fifo.clear (line 259) and rx_fifo.clear (line 304), and the simulation transmitter uses ctrl.sim_mode in its guard (simulation block line 499); it is also read back (masked) at bus_rsp_o.data line 196.

confidentiality.reason: ctrl.sim_mode forces tx_fifo.clear (line 259) and rx_fifo.clear (line 304), so its setting is observable through FIFO behavior and thus externally visible.

integrity.reason: ctrl.sim_mode is written from bus_req_i.data at line 180 (gated by sim_mode_en_c) and can be set while FIFOs are in use, changing FIFO behavior.

availability.reason: When ctrl.sim_mode = '1' the RTL asserts tx_fifo.clear (line 259), which can remove queued data and prevent progress.

undermined behavior.reason: At runtime ctrl.sim_mode is driven only by the bus write (line 180) (with a compile-time sim_mode_en_c gate); there is no alternate runtime override.

concepts.concept: Interrupt-enable bits (ctrl.irq_rx_nempty, ctrl.irq_rx_half, ctrl.irq_rx_full, ctrl.irq_tx_empty, ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf) that qualify irq_rx_o/irq_tx_o
concepts.writers: Each irq enable bit is written by control writes from bus_req_i.data: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty <= ... (line 185), ctrl.irq_rx_half <= ... (line 186), ctrl.irq_rx_full <= ... (line 187), ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= ... (line 188), ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= ... (line 189); resets at lines 161-165 initialize them to '0'.
concepts.observers: Bits are read back via bus_rsp_o.data at lines 208-212 and they directly qualify irq_tx_o (lines 270-272) and irq_rx_o (lines 315-318), which are external outputs.

confidentiality.reason: The irq enable bits are returned on bus reads (e.g. line 208) and also gate external irq outputs (lines 270, 315), making their state externally observable.

integrity.reason: These bits are written directly from bus_req_i.data (example at line 185) and can be changed while interrupts are active, altering interrupt behavior.

availability.reason: The enable bits are ordinary clocked configuration writes (line 185) and there is no external blocker that freezes updates.

undermined behavior.reason: Each interrupt-enable bit has a single runtime driver (control write at lines 185..189) and there is no alternate runtime bypass.

concepts.concept: Received byte exported to the bus (RX FIFO readout, rx_fifo.rdata -> bus_rsp_o.data)
concepts.writers: Received bits are sampled into rx_engine.sync from uart_rxd_i (line 408) and shifted into rx_engine.sreg (line 434); rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0) (line 305) and rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done (line 306) write into the FIFO subunit (rdata_o provided by the FIFO instance at line 300); bus reads copy the FIFO output to bus_rsp_o.data at line 217.
concepts.observers: The received byte is observable on the bus via bus_rsp_o.data when the master reads the data register (line 217); RX-related IRQs (irq_rx_o at line 315) and FIFO status fields are also externally visible.

confidentiality.reason: Received bytes are copied from the RX FIFO into bus_rsp_o.data on bus reads (line 217), so externally-visible masters can learn the data.

integrity.reason: rx_fifo entries are written by the rx_engine when rx_engine.done = '1' (line 306) based on uart_rxd_i samples, so whether the source of those samples is trusted depends on integration.

availability.reason: The RTL asserts rx_fifo.clear when ctrl.clr_rx = '1' (line 304), so an external control write can clear received data and prevent its delivery.

undermined behavior.reason: rx_fifo.rdata originates from the FIFO submodule (rdata_o, line 300) and there is no alternate runtime writer that replaces FIFO output.

concepts.concept: Transmit byte staged in TX FIFO (tx_fifo.wdata and its flow into tx_engine.sreg) that will be sent serially
concepts.writers: Bus writes place transmit bytes onto tx_fifo.wdata (tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c), line 260) and assert tx_fifo.we (line 261); tx_engine loads tx_fifo.rdata into tx_engine.sreg at line 351 when the engine reads the FIFO; tx_fifo.clear (line 259) can clear the FIFO.
concepts.observers: Transmitted bytes exit on the serial output uart_txd_o (uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd at line 392) and FIFO status is visible via bus_rsp_o.data status fields (lines 204-206).

confidentiality.reason: Data written into the TX FIFO is serialized and driven out on uart_txd_o (line 392), so the transmitted content is externally observable.

integrity.reason: TX FIFO write-data is supplied by bus_req_i.data at line 260, so an external bus writer can control or change the bytes staged for transmission.

availability.reason: tx_fifo.clear is asserted when ctrl.enable = '0' or ctrl.sim_mode = '1' or ctrl.clr_tx = '1' (line 259), allowing external control writes to clear queued transmit data and prevent delivery.

undermined behavior.reason: At runtime the FIFO write-data is driven only from the bus write (line 260) and there is no alternate runtime override that substitutes a different write-data path.

concepts.concept: Serialized TX output stream (uart_txd_o) driven by tx_engine.txd
concepts.writers: tx_engine.txd is computed in the transmitter process (initial '1' at line 334/341, driven from tx_engine.sreg bits in the send state at line 365) and is copied to the external port with uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd (line 392).
concepts.observers: The serial stream is externally observable on the uart_txd_o port (line 392).

confidentiality.reason: The serial bit stream is driven onto the external port uart_txd_o (line 392), so the transmitted bits are externally visible.

integrity.reason: tx_engine.txd is produced from tx_engine.sreg (tx_engine.txd <= tx_engine.sreg(0) at line 365) and the sreg content originates from the TX FIFO which is written by the bus, so external writers can indirectly change the transmitted stream.

availability.reason: The transmitter advances only when uart_clk = '1' and either CTS indicates clear or hwfc is disabled (guard at line 359), so an external CTS input (uart_ctsn_i) or hwfc setting can stall transmission.

undermined behavior.reason: uart_txd_o is driven only from tx_engine.txd copied at line 392; there is no separate runtime bypass that substitutes a different driver for the serial pin.

concepts.concept: Serial RX input samples (uart_rxd_i) that feed the RX engine shift register
concepts.writers: The serial input port uart_rxd_i is sampled into rx_engine.sync via rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i (line 408) and the sampled bits are shifted into rx_engine.sreg (line 434) as the receiver runs.
concepts.observers: The assembled received bytes are exposed to the bus via bus_rsp_o.data (line 217) when the FIFO is read and RX status/IRQs (irq_rx_o line 315) reveal FIFO activity, so external agents can learn received data indirectly.

confidentiality.reason: Samples on uart_rxd_i are assembled into bytes and provided on bus_rsp_o.data during reads (line 217), so received data is externally observable.

integrity.reason: uart_rxd_i is an external input sampled into rx_engine.sync at line 408 and the module does not authenticate the source, so the integrity of received samples depends on the external line's trustworthiness.

availability.reason: Receiver start detection relies on rx_engine.sync(1 downto 0) = "01" (line 424), so holding the serial line static prevents detection of a start bit and stops reception.

undermined behavior.reason: Sampling is performed only from the uart_rxd_i port into rx_engine.sync at line 408; there is no alternate runtime source that overwrites those samples.
